notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA) worked for robots.txt, sitemap.xml (index -> sitemap-header.xml, sitemap-footer.xml, sitemap-products.xml) and all catalogue/category pages; all returned HTTP 200 with server-rendered HTML including product counts (no Playwright/Chrome needed). robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket Disallow:/ - only disallows /account,/cart/,/checkout,/order/orderconfirmation. TREE: Built full nav tree from sitemap-header.xml, which enumerates the site's entire filter taxonomy as category_shop query-param values on a small set of base catalogue/category/living/<slug>_<id>/ pages (e.g. home-textiles_194, cushion-covers_47, dining_28, bath-fragrance_210, kids_57, decor_49, drinkware-bar_177, wellness_64) plus Apparel (women/uppers_3, saanjh_576, jewellery_338) and Gifting sections. Cross-checked the full category_shop facet list embedded in fetched pages (sitewide, identical across pages) and sitemap-footer.xml (only static/info pages, no product categories) - confirms no separate Storage/Organization category, subnav, or facet exists anywhere on the site (case-insensitive search for storage/basket/organi/box/crate/trunk across all facet values and fetched category pages found zero matches; Bathroom Accessories = tissue boxes only, decorative not storage). QTY: each leaf's 'N products found' text scraped from its filtered listing page (e.g. .../home-textiles_194/?source=plp&category_shop=Home%20%3E%20Home%20Textiles%20%3E%20Bedspreads); counts differ per filter (15/31/16/94/69/63/12/9) confirming genuine server-side filtering rather than a flat site-wide number. Verified sample product titles (alt text) on filtered pages to confirm real textile products (e.g. Kids Bed & Bath = poncho towel, muslin dohar, muslin tulai - genuine children's home textiles per textile.md SS20; Wallcoverings = printed wallpaper designs, excluded as non-textile Wall Decor per textile.md SS14). Parent category URL rule applied: Home Textiles (3 subcats) and Cushion Covers (2 subcats) recorded as grouping rows with no link/qty on the parent, only on leaves. Table Linen, Towels (bath), and Kids Bed & Bath are each the lone textile-relevant child inside a larger mixed department (Dining; Bath & Fragrance; Kids) whose other children (Dinnerware/Serveware; Aromatherapy/Bath & Bodycare/Bathroom Accessories/LilaNur Parfums; Kids Apparel) are non-textile/non-storage - recorded as standalone leaf rows rather than creating an orphan single-child group header for the mixed parent, to avoid implying the whole department is textile. EXCLUDED: Decor (Vases, Lanterns & Votives, Centerpieces & Accessories, Candles & Stands, Journals, Papier Mache, Wallcoverings) - Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor, not Textile or Storage. Dining > Dinnerware, Serveware - Kitchen & Dining. Drinkware & Bar (all subcats) - Kitchen & Dining. Ancient Rituals / Wellness (Incense & Dhuna, Copperware, Kansa) - Decorative/ritual accessories. Bath & Fragrance > Aromatherapy, Bath & Bodycare, Bathroom Accessories, LilaNur Parfums - fragrance/personal care/decorative, not textile. Kids > Kids Apparel - fashion apparel. Apparel section (Sustain Woman, Saanjh, Jewellery) - fashion/apparel/jewellery, out of scope per textile.md SS19. Gifting section - occasion/recipient landing pages, not product categories. No Storage category, subcategory, or product-listing page exists anywhere on the site; storage_rows is empty for a confirmed reason, not an unchecked gap.
